note: Vision-guided IK sorter (hfteama sort ...). Table frame, seen from BEHIND the arms (facing the camera): origin at the centre of tag 1 (back-left), x to the right along the back tags (tag 2 at x = 0.734), y forward towards the camera (tags 3 and 0 at y = 0.335), z up; metres. Tag centres: 73.4 cm apart along x, 33.5 cm along y. See docs/hardware/sorter.md.

ignore.note: Never pieces: large dark colourless regions (black arm, wrist cameras, cables; Lab chroma < dark_chroma_max, so a dark blue piece still counts) and green ones (green arm), grown by 'grow' m. OpenCV hue 0..180, Lab L 0..255.

arms_note: Arms are named after their pair. Seen from behind the arms: rakesh (black) on the right, hacklab (green) on the left. base = base_link origin in the table frame: 1.5 cm behind the back tags (y = -0.015), 16.3 cm in from the back tag on its side (measured); yaw_deg = heading of the arm's forward axis: +90 = facing the camera (+y).
arms_tuning_note: Per arm, measured with `hfteama sort jog`: z_offset = real tip height minus model (m); offsets_deg = ArmFrame joint zero offsets (rakesh's wrist_roll is 90 deg off the model); aim_offset = [forward, left] shift of the grasp point seen from behind the arm (m).

motion.home_note: Home (camera-clear) pose = the pose the arm has when the sorter connects: leave each arm folded at rest before starting.
